projectDescription: An npm library and CLI tool that resolves candidate portfolios, resume PDFs, and URLs into structured GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket profiles and repositories.
keyFeatures: Classifies URLs into portfolio, git_profile, repo_url, resume_file, resume_url, and linkedin types
Scrapes portfolio sites and git profile pages using fetch, Puppeteer, or Browserless
Parses PDF resumes via both text extraction and hyperlink annotation extraction
Disambiguates candidate ownership from multiple found git profiles and repos using cross-referencing
Categorizes discovered links into ownedRepos, contributions (PRs/Issues), and externalRepos
Supports GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket across all features
Aggregates results from multiple sources (portfolio + resume) into a unified candidate profile
Batch processing from CSV portfolio lists and directories of resume PDFs
Fully typed public TypeScript API exported as an npm package
Three browser providers (fetch / Puppeteer / Browserless) with automatic fallback detection
publicApiSurface: parseRepoUrl(repoUrl: string): { valid: boolean; data?: ParsedRepo; error?: string }
scrapePortfolio(url: string, provider: BrowserProvider, knownOwnerProfile?: ExtractedGitLink): Promise<ResolverResult>
resolveOwnerAndCategorize(links: ExtractedGitLink[], sourceContext?: string, knownOwnerProfile?: ExtractedGitLink): OwnerResolution
